title: Passes manifest
description: One row per raw proposer/verifier execution (run_N). Passes belong to the RUN, not the condition — N-sweeps share a pass pool (consensus-n5 and consensus-n10 are the same passes aggregated differently), so a pass cannot be owned by a single condition. The pass OWNS the generation config and the cost/token/timing facts.

pass_id.description: Primary key. Convention: {run_id}::{proposer_pool}::run{N}. The condition does NOT appear in the key (passes belong to the run).

run_id.description: Foreign key to the runs manifest.

proposer_pool.description: Which generation config produced this pass. Conditions consume the first N passes of a pool.

model_used.description: AUTHORITATIVE model identity, read from per_item_metadata.model_used. NEVER inferred from the directory/condition name — a 'pro-'named condition was verified to have run Flash (memory 2026-05-28-b6bc50ca773e). Empty string allowed only for failed/empty items.

model_requested.description: Model asked for, from per_item_metadata.model_requested (may differ from model_used).

modality.description: Proposer input modality: image when the transmitted configuration set include_example_images over a non-empty exemplar list, text otherwise (derived, never read off a substring of the label — erratum E88; docs/methodology/notation-key.md § 7). A verifier stage's modality, recorded in results/run-conditions.json under verifier_passes, is that stage's OWN exemplar modality by the same rule, not the track it sits beneath.

instruction_hash.description: Hash of the system instruction — captures prompt version AND detects silent drift (better than a version string).

library_hash.description: Hash of the few-shot example library.

n_tiles_processed.description: TILES completed. Proposer passes only. NULL for verifier passes (E72, 2026-08-02): a verifier operates on candidate crops and its meta records candidate ids, never tile ids, so no tile count exists to report — the crop count lives in n_candidates_verified and n_tiles_null_reason says why this is null. Before E72 this column carried the crop count for verifier rows (E71 Defect 2 / GAP-8), which made the column non-comparable across rows; before E71 it carried tiles-dispatched where per_item_metadata existed. Required but nullable: a row must state a tile count or state that none exists.

n_tiles_null_reason.description: Why n_tiles_processed is null. Populated for verifier passes (E72); null whenever n_tiles_processed carries a count. Never a substitute for a derivable count — if genuine tile data appears in a future meta era, the count is recorded and this returns to null.

n_candidates_verified.description: Candidate crops COMPLETED by a verifier pass (E72). Null for proposer passes, which have no candidate stage. This is where the crop-scale count that E71 Defect 2 mislabelled as tiles now lives, under a name that says what it counts.

n_tiles_dispatched.description: TILES dispatched per per_item_metadata, where available (E71). Null for meta eras without per-item records, and null for verifier passes (E72 — per_item_metadata there records candidate-crop API items, not tiles). dispatched minus processed = tiles that produced no output.

tokens.description: Token accounting from usage_stats, summed over the pass's primary meta and every run_N_recovery* fragment it cites in provenance (generator 0.8.0, 2026-10-03; before that, the primary meta only, which dropped 118 M recovery tokens on 57 passes). input_billed INCLUDES input_cached (the API's prompt count does); the fresh input billed at the input rate is input_billed minus input_cached.

cost_usd.description: US dollars on the AUDITED basis (PI ruling D11, 2026-09-21): the pass's own tokens (every fragment in tokens) priced by scripts/lib_cost.price_usage from the dated rate card at the tier each fragment ran at, on its own date. Never the meta's cost_estimate copied (that runner estimate had no cache rate and, on the verifier path, no tier). cost_basis says which kind of figure this is; cost_source says how it was reached. Null, not zero, where no usage was recorded (D12).

cost_basis.description: What cost_usd is. audited: every fragment's tier is pinned by evidence (or every candidate tier prices the same to half a cent). audited-upper-bound: at least one fragment's tier could not be pinned, and it is priced at the HIGHEST candidate tier so the register never understates; cost_source.bounds_usd gives the low and high. audited-lower-bound: a cleanup leg overwrote the pass's meta and no report publishes the leg, so the remaining tokens are priced and the figure is a FLOOR (data/pricing/cost-overrides.json cites why). published: the figure the run's post-run report published, for a pass whose metas can no longer be priced (D13; data/pricing/cost-overrides.json). unrecorded: no usage was recorded; cost_usd is null (D12). unpriceable: usage exists but the rate card has no row for the model or date; cost_usd is null.

cost_source.description: How cost_usd was reached, so the figure re-derives without the generator: the rate card's path, version and sha256; per fragment, the meta priced, the model, the pricing date, the tier and the method that decided it (batch-marker, runner-record, batch-path-pricing, run-log, launch-manifest, attestation, billing-day, verifier-mode, or unresolved), the evidence cited, any conflicts between evidence items, and, where unresolved, the price at each candidate tier. bounds_usd is present when cost_basis is audited-upper-bound; published names the report when cost_basis is published.

timestamps.description: Pass start/end (UTC). These feed the run's derived (not stored) dates_run.

pass.$comment: Lenient back-fill policy: identity (pass_id, run_id, proposer_pool, pass_n), the authoritative model_used, modality, status, n_tiles_processed, and provenance are required. n_tiles_processed stays REQUIRED but is nullable (E72): the contract is that a row must account for its tile coverage — with a count, or with an explicit null plus n_tiles_null_reason. Cost/token/timing fields are nullable so older runs without a cost_manifest.json still validate. cost_basis and cost_source are optional so the schema still reads rows written before generator 0.8.0, but the generator writes both on every row.
